label: gym_koori_010_receptionist_02
text: Let me register you as a challenger. Your name is\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)], yes?

label: gym_koori_010_receptionist_03
text: Great! Now, in order to face Gym Leader\nGrusha, you’ll first need to pass the Gym Test.

label: gym_koori_010_receptionist_04
text: Here at the Glaseado Gym, that means doing\nthe [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Snow Slope Run[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: gym_koori_010_receptionist_05
text: Ride a Pokémon down the designated course and\ntry to reach the goal within the time limit!

label: gym_koori_010_receptionist_06
text: To start your test, just head out of the Gym and\ngo up the slope to your left. We’ll fill you in on\r\nthe details there!

label: gym_koori_010_receptionist_07
text: Now get out there and have fun!
